name: Toast
description: Radix Toast primitives with swipe-to-dismiss and a default and destructive variant. The render host is ui:toaster; the queue is useToast.
intent: Confirm that something happened, without taking the user away from what they are doing.

props.name: variant
props.hint: See variantGuidance in the mirror spec for when to use each.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

variants.name: destructive
variants.when: Failures. Consider whether a ui:alert that stays would serve better.

notes: Radix announces toasts politely and pauses the timer on hover and focus.
ToastAction requires altText — it is what screen-reader users hear as the alternative to the action.
The default duration may be too short to read a long message. Keep toasts to one line.
A dismissed toast is gone. Never put the only copy of important information in one.

usage: Non-blocking errors the user can act on later
Undo affordances after a reversible change
doNotUse: Anything the user must read — toasts disappear and many users will miss them
Errors that block progress — use ui:alert, which stays
Anything needing a decision — use ui:alert-dialog
Long messages, or several at once

agentRules: One line. Keep it short enough to read before it goes.
At most one action per toast.
Never put unrecoverable information in a toast.

related.note: The alternative toast system — pick one

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
